simulation_effects: LivingSim receives read-only faction profiles and may calculate local workshop conditions.
Living Scale records FAC-009 and FAC-010 only as local chartered service overlays.
Future UE5 adapters may import profiles and local chapter data assets but cannot promote them or infer territory.
story_generators: A maintenance backlog creates a local emergency without changing who owns the city.
Two service networks disagree over a contract but must cooperate during a route failure.
A chapter's withdrawal creates a story opportunity, not a new canon border.
